summary: Vercel's MIT-licensed interface guidelines provide useful implementation review prompts for semantics, labels, keyboard and focus behavior, forms, reduced motion, content resilience, images, safe areas, locale formatting, destructive actions, and interaction states. Design DNA adopts only context-stable mechanisms. Title Case, APCA preference, URL-state, and latency advice remain contextual and cannot replace project voice, normative WCAG requirements, or a declared application contract.
